nodes.title: label@1 gains a circuit sketch (C1 item 5): cell (long/short plate), wires, a bulb with its filament, a switch; label-pick gives it to a kit that says 'circuit', names a bulb and >= 3 parts, each label the kit's word ('battery' stays 'battery'). 8 kits; labelled diagrams now reach 23 science/EVS kits (14 plant, 8 circuit, 1 flower), 23/23 pass every W gate timed to her line. Recording docs/design/round7/studio/label-circuit-*. (The first cell anchor sat in the gap between the plates; the leader test caught it, moved onto the long plate.)

## dc-r7-board-circuit-diagram: circuit lessons get a drawn circuit (2026-11-04)

Lessons about electric circuits, conductors and batteries now show a proper circuit diagram (cell, wires, bulb, switch) with each part labelled in the kit's own words. With the plant and flower, 23 science lessons now get a labelled diagram.
